description: List all available individual metrics (210 metrics across bitcoin, calculated, eth, macro categories). Includes Bitcoin price, hash rate, Fed balance sheet, M2 supply, Treasury 10Y yield, net liquidity, and cross-asset indices (SPY, QQQ, VXX, UUP) used as BTC correlation signals. Optionally filter by category or search term. No authentication required. A free key reads the 17 metrics in the bitcoin category in full, and the latest reading of the other 193. The basic and pro tiers read every metric in full.

category.description: Filter by metric category: bitcoin, calculated, eth, macro

search.description: Search term to filter metrics by name or description
